exposure: pregnancy in a non-communicating rudimentary horn of a unicornuate uterus
cohort: A single patient with an 8-week pregnancy in a non-communicating rudimentary horn of a unicornuate uterus.
finding: Early diagnosis and treatment are essential to prevent high maternal risk of life-threatening bleeding complications in cases of pregnancy in a non-communicating rudimentary horn of a unicornuate uterus.
